id: T1
title: Create HelloWorld program
class: boilerplate
depends_on: []
read: []
write: []
create: [src/HelloWorld.java]
protected: []
verify:
  - run: sh -c 'd=$(mktemp -d) && javac -d "$d" src/HelloWorld.java && java -cp "$d" HelloWorld | grep -qx "Hello, World!"'
    timeout_s: 120
---
## Objective
A minimal Java program exists that prints a greeting to standard output.

## Interface
File `src/HelloWorld.java` declaring `public class HelloWorld` with `public static void main(String[] args)`. No package declaration.

## Behavior
1. Running `HelloWorld` prints exactly `Hello, World!` followed by a newline to stdout.
2. The file compiles with plain `javac`, no build tool or dependencies.

## Invariants
Only the standard library is used; nothing else is printed.

## Edge cases
Command-line arguments are ignored.

## Guardrails
Do not add build files, tests, or other files. Do not touch anything outside `src/HelloWorld.java`.

## Out of scope
Build tooling, packaging, unit tests.
